operation_details.item: The user completed the customer discovery interviews.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Hey, finally got through all the customer discovery interviews this morning. It was a marathon, but they're done.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Nice, that's a big milestone. How did the conversations go overall? Any patterns jumping out?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Honestly, a few surprises. People use our product in ways we didn't predict, and some assumptions totally flopped. Good thing we didn't skip this step.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That's exactly what discovery is for. Are you already pulling the findings together, or taking a breather first?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Synthesis is in progress, but I'm trying to be disciplined about it. The interview guide I drafted really helped keep things structured, so organizing the results is less chaotic than I feared.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Smart to lean on the guide. And next week you've got the follow-up interviews lined up, right?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yeah, follow-ups are scheduled. Those should let me dig deeper into the unexpected themes from the first round. I'm curious to see if they hold up.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Sounds like a solid plan. Post-synthesis, you'll probably have a much clearer picture for the next iteration. Keep the momentum going.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Please forget only that I completed the discovery interviews; keep the interview guide, synthesis, and follow-up plan.
